remarks: Pristine unit in The Village at River's Edge in a great location within the complex overlooking the pool. Desirable commuter location within walking distance to train station & convenient to local shops. 2BR plus loft unit that is in immaculate condition.  Kitchen w/granite & Stainless steel Appliances and a balcony. Spacious and sunny living room/dining room combo. Top floor loft can be used as office/recreation/guest room. Lower level offers laundry area & an additional room w/private garage access. Top notch complex has pool w/clubhouse & Gym. 2 Month Security Deposit+ 1 month Rent and Good Credit needed.
